D: A baby circus elephant with enormous ears is mocked until he finds out he can fly.
P: Serve the snacks when Timothy Mouse offers Dumbo a peanut.
S: Popcorn tossed in melted butter, brown sugar and salt
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with butter, brown sugar and a little salt cooked to a quick caramel, spread out to cool, served in red striped cones.
cocktail frankfurts in sweet cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried crunchy on sticks, mustard

Cocktail franks dipped in a sweet cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried golden and crunchy on sticks, with mustard and tomato sauce. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter, then pour into a tall glass. Pat 20 cocktail frankfurts dry, push a skewer into each and dust in flour. Dip into the batter, letting the excess drip off, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
M: Pork loin rubbed with fennel and garlic, roasted with apple, onion and potatoes
Pork loin rubbed with fennel, garlic and salt, roasted at 200C for an hour with apples and onions, sliced with roast potatoes and pan gravy.
parmesan beef balls in slow tomato sauce, tossed through pasta with basil, after the fire act

Parmesan beef meatballs browned and simmered in a slow tomato sauce, tossed through spaghetti and finished with basil and plenty of parmesan. Mix 600g beef mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan, 1 egg, chopped parsley and salt, and roll into 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 20 minutes more. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some of the sauce and top with meatballs, torn basil and grated parmesan.
W: Biscuit base topped with set marshmallow
Biscuit base topped with a fluffy pink marshmallow of gelatine, sugar and vanilla whipped until thick, set overnight and dusted with coconut.
Roasted peanuts in dark chocolate with sea salt
Roasted peanuts stirred into melted dark chocolate with a pinch of salt, spooned into little clusters on baking paper and chilled 30 minutes until set.
K: Fresh lemon juice and crushed raspberries over ice
Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup with crushed raspberries and cold water, poured over ice in tall glasses.

Roast at 200C with apple and onion around it and the potatoes alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Halve, score and rub the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast and make the gravy on the day

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and score the flesh. Rub with 2 tbsp of the oil, the fennel, garlic and salt.
Roast at 200C with apple and onion around it and the potatoes tossed in the remaining oil alongside.
Tip the pan juices into a small pan, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.
Cut the pumpkin into thick slices and spoon over the gravy.
Crush the biscuits with the butter and press into a lined tin.
Soak the gelatine, then dissolve in the hot water with the sugar and simmer.
Cool slightly, whip until thick and white and add pink colouring.
Spread over the base, dust with coconut and set overnight.
Crush the biscuits with the butter and press into a lined tin.
Whisk the agar into the water with the sugar, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until syrupy.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, then pour in the hot syrup while beating and keep whipping until thick, glossy and white. Beat in the pink colouring.
Spread over the base straight away, dust with coconut and chill until set.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Crush the raspberries in a jug, add the lemon juice, syrup and cold water, then strain.
Pour over ice in tall glasses.

s.note: Popcorn tossed in melted butter, brown sugar and salt
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Melt 50g butter with 100g brown sugar and a pinch of salt until bubbling and toss through. Spread out to cool, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

m.note: Pork loin rubbed with fennel and garlic, roasted with apple, onion and potatoes
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg pork loin with crushed fennel seeds, garlic and salt. Roast at 200C for an hour with wedges of apple and onion around it and 1kg potato chunks alongside. Rest, slice and spoon over pan gravy made with the juices.

w.note: Biscuit base topped with set marshmallow
w.how: Crush 250g biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, dissolve in 150ml hot water with 300g sugar and simmer 5 minutes. Cool slightly, whip until thick and white, add pink colouring, spread over the base, dust with coconut and set overnight.

w.note: Roasted peanuts in dark chocolate with sea salt
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and stir in 250g roasted peanuts with a pinch of sea salt. Spoon small clusters onto baking paper and chill for 30 minutes until set. Pile them into paper bags like the peanuts sold under the big top.

d.note: Fresh lemon juice and crushed raspberries over ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Crush 125g raspberries in a jug, add the juice of 6 lemons, the syrup and 1.5L cold water, then strain. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Pink, sweet and gentle as a big-eared baby.
